definitions: checker_side: the quoted words are not a case quotation the draft attributes (a policy name, statutory or constitutional text, legislative history, a lower court's or the record's words, a party's contention) or the checker bound the quotation to a case other than the one the draft names or the Id. points to. model_side: the draft attributes the quotation to the cited case and the words are not in it (paraphrase, invention, or a real quotation from a different case the draft did not cite). standard_alteration: the words are in the cited opinion and the strict standard fails only on a bracketed alteration. ambiguous: the reader could not decide from 200 characters of context.
history: Readings of 40-item samples under earlier rules: about 20 of 40 (original rule), 16 or 17 (first correction), 14, 14 (rounds three and four), 8 (final rule). The 120-item second sample (seed 20260904, disjoint from the first) was read only under the final rule.
